name: Search bar
author: Brett
description: The console's search bar, as a widget that snaps into the banner and any toolbar (as many as you like, three views: full bar, compact, icon). Globe searches everything: every page, plugin, setting, action, asset, window and plan item; gear searches settings only. Results come up letter by letter with its own matching (words, word starts, exact, regular expressions; case and detail options), ranked by AI only when an Ollama (local Llama) connection exists and AI assistance is on. The drop-down has a category column on the left and a tree of matches on the right; pick one to go to it, right-click it for that setting's options (on/off, choices) and pick straight from the list, confirmed by a small check mark. Replaces the old Search everything box.
